    CausalClock.observe(org.apache.kafka.clients.consumer.ConsumerRecord<?,?> record)
    Folds a consumed record into this clock and returns the result: the union of this clock, the clock record carried, and, for a business record, record's own position (topic, partition, offset).
    static CausalClock
    CausalClock.using(Map<String, org.apache.kafka.common.Uuid> topicIds)
    Returns an empty instance bound to a resolver over a fixed name→UUID map — the broker-free path for tests or callers that already hold the UUIDs.
    static CausalClock
    CausalClock.using(Properties props)
    Returns an empty instance bound to a resolver over props, the start of a consumer-side frontier: bind the resolver once here, then CausalClock.observe(ConsumerRecord) each record you consume.
